acceptance_results.evidence: All three seeded defects reported with correct location and mechanism: the pageWindow off-by-one (start = offset + 1 against an exclusive-end cursor, one row lost per page boundary), the check-then-act race in Metrics.reserve across the awaited gauge call, and the swallowed AbortError in withRetry — including the sharper observation that swallowing the wait rejection turns cancellation into a zero-delay retry loop.

Nine findings total (six defects, three minor). Grader verification: the decodeCursor error-contract change and the negative-limit-on-shrunken-total edge are genuine unseeded defects present in the generated fixture, and the tag-keying gauge finding is a real metric-correctness flaw. At most one listed item (duration_ms tag inconsistency, filed under Minor) is a style nit rather than a defect — within the two-non-defect budget. No plausible-but-correct code was flagged.

Every finding states concrete triggering input or interleaving and the observable wrong outcome (e.g. exact row lost at each page boundary, the two-reader interleaving that exceeds the concurrency cap, garbage base64 and encoded-null inputs producing the wrong exception type), each sufficient to write a failing test.
